Strong believer in clean architecture, readable code, and meaningful tests
Collaborative by nature — I thrive in cross-functional teams and async environments

projects-preview.description: A full-stack e-commerce engine with dynamic product catalogues, Stripe payments, and an admin dashboard. Handles 10k+ SKUs with sub-200ms response times.

bio: 5+ years of full-stack development across startups and product companies
Fluent in TypeScript, Python, and Go — comfortable picking up new languages fast
Strong believer in test-driven development and CI/CD best practices
Open-source contributor with repositories spanning CLI tools, UI libraries, and dev utilities
Passionate about developer experience — if the tooling is painful, I fix it
Based in Pakistan, working with clients and teams across Europe, North America, and the Middle East

experience-timeline.description: Leading a team of 6 engineers to build a multi-tenant SaaS platform serving 40,000+ users. Architected the Node.js/PostgreSQL backend, introduced TypeScript across the codebase, and reduced API response times by 62% through query optimisation and Redis caching.

Delivered end-to-end features for a fintech dashboard used by 15 financial institutions. Built a real-time transaction monitoring module with WebSockets and React, and integrated third-party payment APIs including Stripe and PayFast.

Developed responsive marketing sites and e-commerce storefronts for 20+ clients using Next.js and Tailwind CSS. Improved average Lighthouse performance scores from 58 to 91 across the client portfolio.

Kickstarted my professional career building WordPress and Laravel-based solutions for small businesses. Gained hands-on experience with REST API design, MySQL schema modelling, and client communication.

project-details.title: DevFlow deep-dive
project-details.description: Chose a polling-plus-webhook hybrid over pure WebSockets to stay within GitHub API rate limits while keeping the UI responsive. Implemented optimistic UI updates with SWR for a snappy feel on slow connections.

project-details.title: NexAuth deep-dive
project-details.description: Designed the token rotation strategy around a sliding-window refresh model, eliminating the need for a dedicated token blacklist table and cutting Redis memory usage by 40% compared to the naive approach.

project-details.title: ShopSense deep-dive
project-details.description: Embedded a lightweight vector store (pgvector on Supabase) to power the product-affinity engine, avoiding the cost and latency of a dedicated ML inference server for a feature used by sub-100ms dashboard queries.

project-details.title: CodePulse deep-dive
project-details.description: Operational Transformation (OT) was evaluated but ultimately replaced with a CRDT-based conflict resolution layer (Yjs) to handle offline edits and reconnection gracefully without a central OT server.
